messages:
emma: morning  noticed ~82 webinar signups in HubSpot with no owner. likely enrichment timeouts during last night's infra rollout :grimacing:
leo: confirmed. enrichment returned empty owner_id for many leads between 02:10-02:20 UTC. our assignment workflow abandons after 45s and pushes to fallback queue
maria: quick proposal: 1) increase enrichment TTL for webinar forms to 180s, 2) enable 2 retries with jitter, 3) implement a provisional assigner that sets owner = 'provisional-webinar' after 3m then reconciles when enrichment completes
sam: +1 on provisional assigner. also add deterministic rr fallback so these don't pile on the same SDR (hash on email_norm)
emma: HubSpot rules: keep auto-reply immediate; fallback: if owner empty after 3m set owner = sdr_inbound and add note 'pending_enrich'. sales sync should treat provisional-* as non-permanent in SF
leo: I'll open GH PR GH-9203 for TTL/retry changes and include a feature flag ENRICH_OVERRIDE_WEBINAR. will canary and monitor
ops-bot: Deploy started: enrichment-service v4.9-canary by leo at 1805123520
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: enrichment-service v4.9-canary by leo at 1805123555
maria: I'll run a backfill for the last 24h after canary looks good. will rate-limit the job and write timeline notes 'backfilled owner after enrichment'
sales-bot: Created ticket SF-1034 to ensure provisional owners are mapped to a temporary SF queue and not assigned territories
leo: canary success metrics: enrichment owner present rate improved from 84% -> 99% on canary. rolling to 30% now
sam: added RR fallback snippet to PR and a unit test to ensure even distribution when enriched_owner is missing
emma: SLA to add to playbook: webinar handoff target: 90% assigned (provisional or final) < 3m, 99% < 12m. reconciliation to final owner within 24h
maria: scheduling HubSpot fallback rule change for low-impact window 19:00 PT. backfill scheduled at 20:00 PT if rollout stable
leo: monitoring dashboard tile `webinar.assignment.latency` created. will alert if unassigned_count > 40 for > 15m
emma: thanks team. we'll reconvene tomorrow for a 24h readout and adjust SLA if needed :thumbsup:
